subject: Bomb Bag
text: The final Bomb Bag upgrade can be won at the Bombchu Bowling Alley in Hyrule Castle Market, which opens after clearing Dodongo's Cavern.

evidence.quote: Head for Hyrule Castle Market, and go to the newly-opened Bombchu Bowling Alley (it opens after you finish Dodongo's Cavern).  In addition to the Bomb Bag, you can also win: Bombs, Bombchus, a Purple Rupee, and a Piece of Heart.  Just keep playing the game until the clerk offers you the Bomb Bag as a reward.

subject: Bombchu Bowling
text: Bombchu Bowling requires sending a Bombchu into the hole on the opposite end across three increasingly difficult course goals.

evidence.quote: The object of Bombchu Bowling is to send the Bombchu (a mobile bomb) into the hole on the opposite end of the course.  The course has three different goals to obtain, each one becoming progressively more difficult.

subject: Bombchu Bowling
text: For the first goal in Bombchu Bowling, stand slightly to the right of the center arrow and time the release so the Bombchu avoids the Blade Trap.

evidence.quote: For the first goal, the target is always in the center of the field.  Simply stand in the exact middle of the field (slightly to the right of the center arrow is the exact middle of the field) and time it so your Bombchu avoids the Blade Trap.

subject: Bombchu Bowling
text: In the second round the target may appear on the top, left, or right, requiring dodging a small Cucco.

evidence.quote: The next level of the field can be on the top, left, or right, and adds a small Cucco to dodge.

subject: Bombchu Bowling
text: The third goal of Bombchu Bowling is in the center and features a Fat Cucco standing roughly in the middle of the field.

evidence.quote: The last goal is always in the exact center, and adds a Fat Cucco who always stands roughly in the center of the field (but you can sneak a Bombchu by it if you're careful).

subject: Bombchu Bowling
text: Players should stand in the center unless the target is on the right in the second round, or angle along the wall if the hole is on the left.

evidence.quote: When you're playing Bombchu Bowling, always position yourself in the center of the field.  The one exception is when the target appears on the right in the second round; you have to minorly adjust your position to the left or right, otherwise it's impossible to angle yourself properly for the Bombchu to enter the target.  If the hole appears on the left side of the field, then adjust your angle so that the Bombchu goes along the floor, then the wall, then into the hole.

subject: Goron Bracelet
text: Darunia gifts the Goron Bracelet to Young Link after being cheered up with Saria's Song.

evidence.quote: The Goron Bracelet is a gift to Young Link from Darunia, after cheering him up with Saria's Song.

subject: Goron Bracelet
text: The Goron Bracelet increases Link's strength, enabling him to pluck Bomb Flowers from the ground and pick up weeds.

evidence.quote: The Goron Bracelet increases Young Link's strength, giving him the ability to pluck Bomb Flowers from the ground.  He can also pick up weeds... not that you will ever have to.

subject: Silver Gauntlets
text: The Silver Gauntlets are found in the west wing of the Spirit Temple by Young Link and enable Adult Link to push and pull huge blue blocks.

evidence.quote: Obtained late in the adventure, the Silver Gauntlets are found by Young Link, though only Adult Link can use them.  Once he has the Silver Gauntlets, then he can push and pull the huge blue blocks that appear in the Spirit Temple and Gerudo Training Ground.

subject: Gold Gauntlets
text: The Gold Gauntlets are found in Ganon's Castle and allow Adult Link to lift and throw large black obelisks.

evidence.quote: With the Gold Gauntlets, Link can lift up the black obelisks that appear in Ganon's Castle and throw them aside.  One of the black obelisks hides the game's last Fairy Fountain, another hides a door in the Keep, and the last is needed to finish the Fire Seal.

subject: Silver Scale
text: The Silver Scale is won from the diving minigame at the top of the waterfall in Zora's Domain, accessed through the tunnel in King Zora's throne room.

evidence.quote: The Silver Scale is won from the diving minigame at the top of the Zora's Domain waterfall.  Go left through the tunnel in King Zora's throne room to reach it.

subject: Silver Scale
text: The Silver Scale increases Link's diving depth from 3 meters to 6 meters and is required to get the third bottle and enter Zora's Fountain.

evidence.quote: The Silver Scale doubles Link's diving depth from 3 meters to 6 meters.  It is required to obtain the game's third bottle and access Zora's Fountain.

subject: Diving Minigame
text: To complete the diving minigame, hold A while diving to collect all the rupees thrown off the waterfall by the Zora.

evidence.quote: The Zora will throw a handful of rupees off the waterfall, which you need to dive down and grab.  Simply position yourself above the rupees, and hold down A as you dive down to grab them...Once you have grabbed all of the rupees from around the waterfall, the Zora will call down for you to return to him and he'll give you a reward.  He'll give you the Silver Scale, which doubles how deep you can go in a single dive.

subject: Fishing Pond
text: The largest fish in the pond are found near the submerged log on the left and the reeds on the right.

evidence.quote: The biggest fish are found near the submerged log on the left side of the pond and the reeds on the right.  Once a fish is on the line, hold down A and pull backwards on the control stick to reel the fish in.

subject: Fishing Pond
text: Fish that break free disappear permanently, but exiting and re-entering the Fishing Pond causes them to respawn.

evidence.quote: The unfortunate downside to this is that once a fish breaks free from the line, it disappears permanently.  If the pond starts running low on larger fish, then leave it and re-enter, and they will respawn.  I find it also helps to alternate between holding back and to the left, and back and to the right every few seconds while you reel the fish in.

subject: Epona
text: Obtaining Epona as Adult Link requires having learned Epona's Song as Young Link at Lon Lon Ranch.

evidence.quote: Epona is won from Lon Lon Ranch, and can be obtained immediately after becoming Adult Link (it can, and should, be your first task as Adult Link).  First, you're going to need Epona's Song, so if you didn't learn that as Young Link then you'll have to visit Lon Lon Ranch in the past and learn it.

subject: Ingo
text: Paying Ingo 10 rupees to enter the paddock, playing Epona's Song, jumping both fences, and talking to him while riding triggers a race for 50 rupees.

evidence.quote: Pay him 10 rupees, and when you enter the paddock, ignore the horse that Ingo offers you.  Play Epona's Song, and the now fully-grown Epona will run towards you...Jump over both of the fences in the course to make back your ten rupees, then speak with Ingo...speak with Ingo WHILE you are riding Epona (z-target him to make it easier), and Ingo will challenge you to a race for 50 rupees.  Accept the challenge.

subject: Ingo
text: Ingo can be defeated in the horse race by staying in front of his path or hugging the inside rail while pacing carrot usage.

evidence.quote: Defeat Ingo by getting in front of him, and carefully steering Epona so that you stay in front of his path.  Alternatively, you can also use a steady amount of carrots and hug the inside the rail.  Use your first four carrots quickly, then wait for one to regenerate, then use another carrot, then wait for it to regenerate, then use another, etc. etc.

subject: Ingo
text: Ingo cheats by starting 1 second early in the second race, but running inside and cutting in front when he takes corners wide defeats him.

evidence.quote: Defeat Ingo, and he'll challenge you to another race.  And this time, if you win, he'll let you keep Epona.  Agree.  On this race, Ingo will cheat, and start a second before the clock says Go...He tends to take the corners very wide, so that's your opportunity to move in front of him.

subject: Epona
text: After beating Ingo twice, run counter-clockwise around the paddock and burn all carrots to jump the locked gate into Hyrule Field to win Epona.

evidence.quote: Once you defeat Ingo for the second time, he'll honor his bet, but he'll also prevent you from leaving the Ranch by closing the gate.  To make it over the gate, you must run around the path around the paddock in a counter-clockwise pattern.  Once you come around the corner and see the gate, burn all of your carrots at once and charge straight at the gate...Once you make it over the gate, then you will return to Hyrule Field and Epona will become yours.

subject: Super Spin Attack
text: The Super Spin Attack adds two magic-consuming charge levels that double range at blue and triple range at red.

evidence.quote: This upgrade increases the range of Link's Spin Attack by a wide margin, and gives it two charge levels.  The first level, blue, doubles the range of the Spin Attack, and the second level, red, triples the range...Both levels of the Super Spin Attack use a small amount of the magic meter.

subject: Spin Attack
text: A blue Super Spin Attack can be executed quickly by rotating the joystick and attacking, while releasing B just as the sword glows blue costs no magic.

evidence.quote: You can quickly execute a blue level Super Spin Attack by rotating the joystick and pressing the attack button...If you like, you can still execute a standard Spin Attack by holding down the B-Button, and releasing it just as the sword glows blue.  The spin attack will execute, but will not use any Magic Power.

subject: Super Spin Attack
text: The Super Spin Attack is obtained from the Great Fairy of Power on Death Mountain peak by bombing the rock formation to the left of the Crater entrance.

evidence.quote: The Super Spin Attack is obtained from the Great Fairy of Power on the peak of Death Mountain.  Use a bomb to blow open the odd formation of rock to the left of the entrance to Death Mountain Crater to find the entrance to the fountain.

subject: Magic Meter Upgrade
text: The Magic Meter Upgrade doubles the Magic Meter and is received from the Great Fairy of Power behind silver rocks smashed with the Megaton Hammer.

evidence.quote: The Magic Meter Upgrade doubles the size of the Magic Meter.  It is obtained from the Great Fairy of Power, who resides behind a pair of silver rocks in the lower half of Death Mountain Crater.  Use the Megaton Hammer to smash the rocks blocking the entrance to the cave.

subject: Defense Upgrade
text: The Defense Upgrade is granted by the Great Fairy of Courage outside Ganon's Castle behind a black obelisk requiring the Gold Gauntlet to move.

evidence.quote: A gift from the Great Fairy of Courage, who lives near the bridge of light that leads into Ganon's Castle.  To access the fountain, you have to have the Gold Gauntlet.  Head down the path behind the shattered arch, where you will find one of the game's black obelisks.  Pick it up and toss it aside to gain access to the fountain.

subject: Deku Stick Capacity Upgrade #1
text: A Business Scrub in the southwest valley of the Lost Woods sells a Deku Stick capacity upgrade from 10 to 20 for forty rupees.

evidence.quote: A Business Scrub in the southwest valley of the Lost Woods sells he upgrade for forty rupees.  It raises your Deku Stick capacity from 10 to 20 (and also maxes your Deku Sticks).

subject: Deku Stick Capacity Upgrade #2
text: Wearing the Skull Mask on the platform before the Deku Scrubs at the Forest Stage in the Lost Woods increases Deku Stick capacity to 30.

evidence.quote: The second Deku Stick Upgrade can be obtained from the Forest Stage, but requires the Skull Mask.  The Forest Stage is located in the clearing near the center of the Lost Woods...Drop down into the Forest Stage, equip the Skull Mask, and stand on the platform before the Deku Scrubs.  They'll award you with the Deku Stick upgrade, which raises your capacity to 30.

subject: Gold Scale
text: The Gold Scale increases Link's diving depth to nine meters and is won at the Fishing Pond with Adult Link by catching a record breaking fish of fifteen pounds.

evidence.quote: The Gold Scale increases Link's diving depth to nine meters, it's maximum length...The Gold Scale is won from the Fishing Pond with Adult Link, though Young Link can benefit from it's effects as well...In order to win the Gold Scale, you have to capture a record breaking fish: fifteen pounds.
